samples.question: The image has a REFERENCE panel and candidates A and B. Each panel contains five isolated, uniquely colored open boxes. The gap direction is the side of a square outline that is missing: UP, RIGHT, DOWN, or LEFT. Which candidate has exactly the same mapping from color to gap direction as the REFERENCE? Boxes may be rearranged and resized; ignore panel position, box position, box size, and box order. Answer A or B.
